name: Admin Accounting Hosting Cycle Payments
description: Superuser registers hosting cycle payments from the clock action at /panel/accounting/hostings: the modal shows the cycle history (modality + amount snapshotted per paid period, consolidated 'histórico' backfill rows flagged) and a register form prefilled from the contract (amount = payment_per_cycle, modality, paid_at = today) with an 'Extender vigencia' toggle (on by default: valid_to advances one modality period, re-arming the expiry notices). total_paid/cycles_count recompute from the history; deleting a cycle recalculates but never rolls back valid_to.
